remarks: Welcome to your new home! This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offers comfort, convenience, and great community amenities. Enjoy the ease of an attached garage plus an extra parking space, perfect for guests or multiple vehicles. Inside, you'll find a bright and open layout with spacious and plenty of storage bedrooms, kitchen and extra room perfect for office or gym. Step outside and take advantage of the community swimming pool, basketball court, and playground - ideal for family fun and relaxation. The condo has been well maintained and updated over the years, featuring fresh finishes and thoughtful improvements throughout. Located just minutes from the train station and shopping centers, this home is perfect for commuters and anyone who loves easy access to dining, entertainment, and daily essentials. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in ready home in a highly desirable location!
